rules: Exact authoritative full name and authorship; only whitespace/case/Unicode normalization
Explicit source autonyms may identify their supported species parent without claiming acceptance of their infraspecific rank
Retain accepted taxon and ancestor identities; matching catalog concept must contain the source concept
Never infer sibling subspecies identity from a shared species ancestor
Hold ambiguous catalog concepts, unsupported authors, hybrids and unplaced or misapplied names

references.qualification: Nomenclature describes name relationships; it does not by itself establish present taxonomic circumscription. No full Code text redistributed.

regressionFinding.issue: An early diagnostic collapsed every catalog name to a species ancestor, allowing an invalid sibling-subspecies match.
regressionFinding.example: Sorghum bicolor subsp. bicolor must not establish Sorghum arundinaceum, which this release treats as a synonym of a different subspecies.
regressionFinding.action: Rejected trial retained; require catalog accepted-concept containment in the source ancestry; added sibling-subspecies regression before any admission.
